title-group.article-title: Trastuzumab in HER2-positive early breast cancer

abstract.p: Disease-free survival was improved with trastuzumab.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive chemotherapy with or without one year of trastuzumab. Randomization was stratified by nodal status.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: At a median follow-up of 8 years, overall survival was significantly improved with trastuzumab; the hazard ratio for death was 0.66 (95% CI 0.57 to 0.77).
Disease-free survival at 3 years was 81% versus 74% (hazard ratio 0.64).
